tutor_subjects_specialty_length.name: tutor_subjects_specialty_length
tutor_subjects_specialty_length.value: "tutor_subjects"."specialty" IS NULL OR char_length("tutor_subjects"."specialty") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

learner_profiles_management.name: learner_profiles_management
learner_profiles_management.value: ("learner_profiles"."management" = 'guardian' AND "learner_profiles"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("learner_profiles"."management" = 'self' AND "learner_profiles"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_profiles"."level" = 'college_support')

booking_lifecycle_shape.name: booking_lifecycle_shape
booking_lifecycle_shape.value: ("booking_lifecycle_events"."event"='demo_rescheduled' AND "booking_lifecycle_events"."replacement_booking_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("booking_lifecycle_events"."event"<>'demo_rescheduled' AND "booking_lifecycle_events"."replacement_booking_id" IS NULL)

bookings_revision_valid.name: bookings_revision_valid
bookings_revision_valid.value: "bookings"."revision">=0 AND (("bookings"."revision"=0 AND "bookings"."replaces_booking_id" IS NULL AND "bookings"."logical_booking_id"="bookings"."id") OR ("bookings"."revision">0 AND "bookings"."replaces_booking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."logical_booking_id"<>"bookings"."id"))

support_case_events_shape.name: support_case_events_shape
support_case_events_shape.value:
(
    ("support_case_events"."action" = 'created' AND "support_case_events"."revision" = 0 AND "support_case_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "support_case_events"."previous_status" IS NULL AND "support_case_events"."next_status" = 'open' AND "support_case_events"."previous_reviewer_id" IS NULL AND "support_case_events"."next_reviewer_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("support_case_events"."action" IN ('assigned','reassigned') AND "support_case_events"."revision" > 0 AND "support_case_events"."actor_user_id" IS NULL AND "support_case_events"."previous_status" IS NULL AND "support_case_events"."next_status" IS NULL AND "support_case_events"."next_reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND (("support_case_events"."action" = 'assigned' AND "support_case_events"."previous_reviewer_id" IS NULL) OR ("support_case_events"."action" = 'reassigned' AND "support_case_events"."previous_reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "support_case_events"."previous_reviewer_id" <> "support_case_events"."next_reviewer_id")))
    OR ("support_case_events"."action" = 'status_changed' AND "support_case_events"."revision" > 0 AND "support_case_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "support_case_events"."previous_reviewer_id" IS NULL AND "support_case_events"."next_reviewer_id" IS NULL AND (("support_case_events"."previous_status" = 'open' AND "support_case_events"."next_status" = 'in_review') OR ("support_case_events"."previous_status" = 'in_review' AND "support_case_events"."next_status" = 'closed') OR ("support_case_events"."previous_status" = 'closed' AND "support_case_events"."next_status" = 'in_review')))
  ) IS TRUE

booking_notice_attempts.name: booking_notice_attempts
booking_notice_attempts.value: "booking_notification_deliveries"."attempts" >= 0 AND (("booking_notification_deliveries"."attempts" = 0 AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."last_attempt_at" IS NULL) OR ("booking_notification_deliveries"."attempts" > 0 AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."last_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL))

booking_notice_shape.name: booking_notice_shape
booking_notice_shape.value:
(
    ("booking_notification_deliveries"."state" = 'pending' AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."suppressed_reason" IS NULL AND (("booking_notification_deliveries"."attempts" = 0 AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."failure_code" IS NULL) OR ("booking_notification_deliveries"."attempts" > 0 AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."failure_code" = 'capture_unavailable')))
    OR ("booking_notification_deliveries"."state" = 'captured' AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."attempts" > 0 AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."failure_code" IS NULL AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."suppressed_reason" IS NULL)
    OR ("booking_notification_deliveries"."state" = 'suppressed' AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."attempts" > 0 AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."failure_code" IS NULL AND "booking_notification_deliveries"."suppressed_reason" = 'outdated_or_unauthorized')
  ) IS TRUE

booking_notice_finite_times.name: booking_notice_finite_times
booking_notice_finite_times.value: isfinite("booking_notification_deliveries"."created_at") AND ("booking_notification_deliveries"."last_attempt_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("booking_notification_deliveries"."last_attempt_at")) AND ("booking_notification_deliveries"."closed_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("booking_notification_deliveries"."closed_at"))

account_restriction_events_shape.name: account_restriction_events_shape
account_restriction_events_shape.value: (("account_restriction_events"."previous_status" = 'active' AND "account_restriction_events"."next_status" = 'suspended' AND "account_restriction_events"."reason" IN ('local_access_test','local_review_test')) OR ("account_restriction_events"."previous_status" = 'suspended' AND "account_restriction_events"."next_status" = 'active' AND "account_restriction_events"."reason" = 'local_restore_test')) IS TRUE

support_assignment_events_shape.name: support_assignment_events_shape
support_assignment_events_shape.value: ("support_assignment_events"."actor_user_id" <> "support_assignment_events"."next_reviewer_id" AND (("support_assignment_events"."kind" = 'assign' AND "support_assignment_events"."previous_reviewer_id" IS NULL) OR ("support_assignment_events"."kind" IN ('reassign','escalate') AND "support_assignment_events"."previous_reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "support_assignment_events"."previous_reviewer_id" <> "support_assignment_events"."next_reviewer_id"))) IS TRUE
